initialize_dp_attention: initialize DP attention parallelism configuration from server and model arguments
dp_gather_partial: gather tokens from all data parallel ranks into a global buffer with partial aggregation
dp_gather_replicate: gather tokens from all data parallel ranks into a global buffer with full replication
dp_scatter: scatter global aggregated tokens back to the local data parallel rank buffer
compute_dp_attention_world_info: compute data parallel and tensor parallel rank layout for attention parallelism
